description: energy-floor gate at default silenceThreshold=0.005 -- just below threshold. Signal: a Nyquist-frequency square wave (raw i16 samples alternating +amplitude/-amplitude every sample) scaled so its normalized amplitude equals target_normalized_rms. A Butterworth highpass has EXACT unity gain at Nyquist (proven: the filtered RMS matches the raw normalized amplitude to float precision), so feeding this through the real production seam (KlarvoAudioRecorder.vadGateFilteredFrame + calculateRmsFloat) yields a filtered RMS within quantization noise (~1e-5) of target_normalized_rms -- far smaller than the 0.001 gap to the neighboring vectors, so gate-open/closed outcomes are unaffected by the approximation.
energy-floor gate at default silenceThreshold=0.005 -- at threshold (>= semantics). Same Nyquist-square-wave signal construction as VAD-GATE-001.
energy-floor gate at default silenceThreshold=0.005 -- above threshold. Same Nyquist-square-wave signal construction as VAD-GATE-001.
energy-floor gate at a tuned silenceThreshold=0.02 -- just below threshold. Same Nyquist-square-wave signal construction as VAD-GATE-001.
energy-floor gate at a tuned silenceThreshold=0.02 -- at threshold (>= semantics). Same Nyquist-square-wave signal construction as VAD-GATE-001.
energy-floor gate at a tuned silenceThreshold=0.02 -- above threshold. Same Nyquist-square-wave signal construction as VAD-GATE-001.
stop-latency (frames-to-stop) at default silenceSecs=2.0 -- ceil(2.0 * 31.25) = 63 (AC6); above the AC2 7-frame floor
stop-latency at a tuned silenceSecs=0.5 -- ceil(0.5 * 31.25) = 16; still above the AC2 7-frame floor
stop-latency at a very small tuned silenceSecs=0.05 -- exercises the AC2 200ms-equivalent floor (ceil(0.05 * 31.25) = 2, floored up to 7)
